verdict.rationale: Apple's own pages describe a built-in capability that automatically passes what you're doing between a nearby Mac and iPhone or iPad so you can pick up where you left off. Further examples include continuing video editing on iPhone and resuming Siri conversations across devices. The evidence is marketing-level first-party copy only. Missing for 10: detailed docs on supported apps and setup/pairing requirements, independent or hands-on corroboration that handoff works reliably.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can start a task on one device and finish it on another paired device

citations.quote: When your Mac and your iPhone or iPad are near each other, they can automatically pass what you’re doing from one device to another.
Just click or tap to pick up right where you left off without having to search for the file.
You can even drag and drop a video from your Mac to your iPhone, so you can continue editing on the go.
so you can ask a question on your iPhone and pick up where you left off on your Mac.
